claim: For every item sold, Amazon charges a referral fee equal to a percentage of the total price or a minimum amount, whichever is greater.
evidence: For every item sold, you’ll pay a percentage of the total price or a minimum amount, whichever is greater.

claim: An item's total price for referral fees includes its list price plus shipping costs and any gift-wrapping charges.
evidence: An item’s total price includes its list price, as well as shipping costs and any gift-wrapping charges.

claim: The Home and Kitchen referral fee is 15% with a $0.30 minimum.

claim: Clothing and Accessories pays 10% for products with a total sales price greater than $15.00 and up to $20.00.

claim: Clothing and Accessories pays 17% for products with a total sales price greater than $20.00.

claim: Jewelry pays 20% on the portion of the total sales price up to $250.00 and 5% on any portion above $250.00.
